policies.defaultFitTip: Our juttis fit true to standard EU sizes. If you have broad feet or fall between sizes, we recommend sizing up for effortless all-day comfort.
defaultCareInstructions: Keep away from water and damp surfaces; authentic leather absorbs moisture.
Store in the breathable cotton dust bag provided with silica gel packets.
Clean delicately with a soft, dry cotton cloth after wearing to maintain beadwork lustre.
Air dry in a shaded, ventilated breeze if accidentally exposed to dampness.
